subject: Evaluation launch planning for FinBridge - scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Clara Jensen <clara@finbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery — next steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call earlier. The team appreciated the quick demo and the conversation about latency/cost tradeoffs — that was exactly the kind of production-minded discussion we needed. We summarized internal notes and agreed we'd like to run a short evaluation to validate latency at our 2k average tokens/session workload and try the prompt-set you suggested.

Next step: can we schedule an evaluation launch meeting (technical deep dive + trial plan) next week? Suggested attendees from our side: myself (product), Tom Hsu (ML engineer), and our procurement lead (Maya Park) if we get to initial SOW/pricing. Prefer windows: Tue 5/12 morning (PST) or Wed 5/13 late morning. If those don't work, we can flex.

Success criteria from our side:
- 95th percentile latency <= 600ms for the average 2k token session under a representative load
- Embedding similarity A/B above current baseline for a specific prompt set (will share)
- Clear mutual action plan for the 14-day trial and handoff to production

Can you confirm availability and send a calendar invite with an agenda? Also please share a short checklist of pre-work and any artifacts we should surface (logs, sample prompt set).

Thanks,
Clara
Clara Jensen
Product Manager, FinBridge
clara@finbridge.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara@finbridge.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finbridge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery — next steps

Clara — really great to meet you and Tom earlier. Appreciate the clarity on success criteria.

Short recap from our side:
- Trial target: 14-day evaluation against your prompt set, focused on latency and embedding quality.
- Engineering participants: we'll run a 90-minute technical deep dive to validate integration, sample load test, and KV/prefix caching options.
- Deliverables: mutual action plan (MAP), trial data plan, and a prework prompt set so we can baseline quality before load.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 12 May, 9:30–11:00 AM
- Tue 12 May, 11:30 AM–1:00 PM
- Wed 13 May, 10:00–11:30 AM

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick intros & goals (10m)
2) Technical architecture + integration touchpoints (20m)
3) Trial plan and success criteria review (20m)
4) Prompt set baseline demo & quality checks (25m)
5) Action items & MAP ownership (15m)

Pre-work from FinBridge: a representative sample of 50–100 prompts (anonymized) and a note on expected concurrency patterns. We'll send our MAP and a trial data plan as attachments.

CC'ing Vanessa (our Solutions Engineer) to help lock calendar times and include the right trial runbook. If the procurement lead will be on the call, great — otherwise procurement can join a subsequent commercial discussion.

Thoughts? If any of the suggested windows work, I'll send an invite and include the trial artifacts.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Clara Jensen <clara@finbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery — next steps

Jordan — thanks, that all looks good. We can do Tue 12 May, 11:30 AM–1:00 PM PST. I'll invite Tom and Maya Park (procurement) tentatively; Maya may only sit in for the end to confirm commercial questions.

One note on the prompt set: we'll share an anonymized CSV with 75 prompts and a short description of the expected output format by EOD Monday. Tom will ping you separately with any infra constraints.

Please go ahead and send the invite and attach the MAP so we can align internally.

Best,
Clara
